---
title: "NY NOAA Weather Dashboard: New York City, 2010"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)

data("ny_noaa")

nrow(ny_noaa)
ncol(ny_noaa)

nyc_weather_df =
  ny_noaa |>
  filter(id %in% c("USW00094728", "USW00094789", "USW00014732")) |>
  separate(date, into = c("year", "month", "day"), sep = "-") |>
  mutate(
    year = as.numeric(year),
    month = as.numeric(month),
    day = as.numeric(day),
    prcp = prcp / 10,
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10,
    station = case_match(
      id,
      "USW00094728" ~ "Central Park",
      "USW00094789" ~ "JFK",
      "USW00014732" ~ "LaGuardia")) |>
  filter(year == 2010)
```

Column {data-width=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Daily Max vs. Min Temperature (°C), NYC stations, 2010

```{r}
nyc_weather_df |>
  filter(!is.na(tmax), !is.na(tmin)) |>
  mutate(
    `Min Temp (°C)` = tmin,
    `Max Temp (°C)` = tmax,
    text_label = str_c(
      "Station: ", station,
      "\nDate: ", year, "-", month, "-", day,
      "\nMax temp: ", tmax, " °C",
      "\nMin temp: ", tmin, " °C")) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~`Min Temp (°C)`, y = ~`Max Temp (°C)`,
    type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
    color = ~station, text = ~text_label, alpha = 0.5)
```
